for name,box,offset in [('ball',(540,535,1160,900),(750,99)),('duck',(2140,725,2900,1260),(-800,-105))]:

 mask=np.zeros(crop.shape[:2],np.uint8)
 if name=='ball':
  cv2.ellipse(mask,(746-x0,698-y0),(137,135),0,0,360,255,-1)
  cv2.ellipse(mask,(878-x0,754-y0),(205,82),-13,0,360,255,-1)
 else:
  pts=np.array([(2400,760),(2675,750),(2720,852),(2835,865),(2850,1050),(2780,1145),(2630,1200),(2400,1180),(2330,1080),(2220,965),(2235,830)],np.int32)
  cv2.fillPoly(mask,[pts-[x0,y0]],255)
 # copy the grain then match all boundary illumination using Poisson blending
 clean=cv2.seamlessClone(donor,crop,mask,(crop.shape[1]//2,crop.shape[0]//2),cv2.NORMAL_CLONE)
 # seamlessClone recentering is defined with respect to mask bbox, not source bbox.

 bg[y0:y1,x0:x1]=clean
